newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin medical bulletin planned after 1400 GMT.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin medical bulletin planned after 1400 GMT.

text.p: President Boris Yeltsin's doctors will meet at 5 p.m. (1400 GMT) on Tuesday and issue a bulletin on his health after the session, a Kremlin spokeswoman said.
She told Reuters that no statement was planned before that time and she had no information on when Yeltsin, 65, who is suffering from pneumonia, might be released from hospital.

The Russian leader has been in Moscow's elite Central Clinical Hospital since last Wednesday night. His chief doctor said on Friday he would need at least three more days in the hospital, followed by three weeks convalescence.

Doctors and aides have insisted that his latest illness has nothing to do with Yeltsin's heart bypass operation on November 5. But it has been a political blow to the president, who only returned to work at his Kremlin office on December 23.
Yeltsin's press secretary said on Monday that the president's condition was stable but he gave no indication of a possible hospital departure date.
